notes: Copper's Dev API supports API-key auth (per-user token generated in System settings, sent via header + user email) and OAuth2.0 (preferred for partner/third-party integrations, Authorization Code flow). API access is gated to paid plan tiers (Professional/Business per copper.com/pricing feature comparison; Basic plan lacks it), but Copper offers a 14-day no-credit-card free trial that includes higher-tier features, so a developer can self-serve a trial account and generate an API key without admin approval or a sales conversation. No official Copper-published MCP server found (registry hit for "copperline-labs/rendex-mcp" appears unrelated to Copper CRM); several small community/unofficial MCP servers exist on GitHub (e.g. Pond-International/copper-mcp-server, dazanza/copper-mcp, charlesmmorais/coppermind), none with significant adoption. API breadth estimated as medium based on ~15 documented resource categories (Leads, People, Companies, Opportunities, Projects, Tasks, Account, Users, Tags, Activities, Custom Fields, Field Layouts, Webhooks, Related Items, File Upload) with standard CRUD/list endpoints each; exact endpoint count not enumerated in fetched pages.
